title: DEUTERONOMY 28:7
THE MIDNIGHT WATCH
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight
stock_queries: midnight watchtower silhouette under starry sky
deep dark starry heavens with subtle northern lights
ancient stone fortress wall in moonlight
lamp-lit sanctuary vigil dark wooden desk
calm mountain lake at night reflecting stars
tranquil dark forest under glowing crescent moon

scenes.a: If you lie awake tonight sensing unseen opposition closing in around your life, hear this word.
Father, we come before Your throne in this quiet hour acknowledging that battles surround us on every side.
We stand our ground and declare Your holy truth over every adversary rising against our peace.
The LORD shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.
Lord, let Your mighty shield scatter every darkness and grant us unshakeable peace until morning light breaks.
